resources.string: Diablo II game files: the game\'s own folder, change with care
This folder cannot be removed, renamed or moved.
Diablo II is running: it writes its folder, and the characters when it closes. Change files once it has closed.
Diablo II is starting: the Launcher is preparing its files. Change files once it has closed, or if it does not start.
The Launcher is working on the game folder. Change files once it is done.
Your Diablo II folder is in Android\'s Files app, under PD2 Launcher.
